summary: This class contained almost no course logistics. The only administrative information was that the next class session on 2025-12-11 will be dedicated to exercises using healthy-population and patient databases. No exams, deadlines, assignments, grading changes, groups, attendance, or room changes were announced.

items.title: Next week exercises session
items.details: The teacher said that next week (2025-12-11) the class will go through exercises using databases of healthy population and patients, looking at genetic reports and how some variants relate to disease.
